summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend E2E testing for AgriMill Hub. 21/21 backend pytest cases pass covering auth (cookies, invalid, logout), products/inventory (create/list/purchase-increments/sale-decrements), sales (invoice auto-gen + PDF + Excel export), grinding (no stock impact), oil (no stock impact), expenses, customers (outstanding aggregation, history), suppliers (outstanding), dashboard (all keys + 6-month trend + revenue_breakdown), notifications (low_stock/pending_payment/supplier_due), invoices list, and RBAC (staff blocked from DELETE product with 403, admin allowed). Frontend Playwright E2E validated login as admin, all 9 sidebar nav items present, product & purchase creation with stock update (stock went from 0 to 100 kg for UI_Wheat), sale, grinding, oil, expense, customer and supplier creation flows, invoices page shows INV- numbers, dashboard renders all metric cards + Income vs Expenses bar chart + Revenue Breakdown pie chart + Low Stock/Dues Summary, notification bell badge shows 6, theme toggle button responds, and logout returns to /login.

minor.issue: Uses get_current_user instead of require_admin — inconsistent with delete pattern used for products/purchases/sales/grinding/oil (all admin-only). Staff can delete expenses currently.
CORSMiddleware allow_origins uses FRONTEND_URL only; env has CORS_ORIGINS='*' which is unused. With allow_credentials=True and single explicit origin this works but CORS_ORIGINS env is dead code.

6-month trend built via `datetime.now().replace(day=1) - timedelta(days=i*30)` — inaccurate for month boundaries (30-day approximation can duplicate/skip months in Feb/long months). Prefer proper month arithmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: A benign 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' warning triggers the CRA red overlay iframe which intercepts pointer events and blocks all clicks. Repro: open app, add a product, then click Tabs trigger — click is blocked. Only present in dev build (react-scripts). Recommend adding a ResizeObserver error swallower in index.js or upgrading to Vite/silencing the warning.
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — Radix a11y warning; add DialogDescription to each dialog.

integration_issues.issue: When no customers exist, sale-customer dropdown only offers 'Walk-in' fallback but selecting it did not populate f.customer_name in one run, resulting in toast 'Fill all fields'. Second attempt worked. Verify Walk-in fallback SelectItem value is a non-empty string and sets f.customer_name reliably.

issues: Warm earthy theme applied correctly, charts render with brand color #B8860B, contrast is good in light mode. Consider showing empty-state placeholder in Revenue Breakdown pie when values are 0.

action_items: Consider tightening RBAC on DELETE /api/expenses to admin-only for consistency.
Silence ResizeObserver warning in frontend (index.js) so CRA dev overlay does not block interactions.
Add DialogDescription to shadcn Dialog components to remove Radix a11y warning.
Confirm Walk-in fallback on Sales/Grinding/Oil customer selects sets f.customer_name properly.
Optional: Fix 6-month trend month arithmetic in /api/dashboard (use relativedelta or manual month math).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 669 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into modules (auth, products, sales, services, reports).
DELETE /api/expenses uses get_current_user (any authenticated user) whereas all other DELETE endpoints require admin. Inconsistent RBAC.
hash_password/verify_password use bcrypt correctly ($2b$ hash) and admin seed idempotently rehashes if password changed — good.
httpOnly cookies with samesite=none + secure=true correctly set for cross-site frontend; matches spec.
Brute force lockout after 5 attempts + 15-min lockout implemented correctly.
MongoDB _id properly stripped via clean() helper before returning to client.
CORS: allow_credentials=True with explicit FRONTEND_URL origin — correct for cookie auth.
Purchase/Sale DELETE endpoints correctly reverse the stock adjustment before deletion — good data-integrity.
Frontend axios uses withCredentials via /lib/api.js — cookies work across preview domain.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes — excellent testability.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all critical flows work; minor dev-overlay pointer-event issue)

Cleanup fixture removes TEST_ prefixed products/customers/suppliers via admin session. Sales/grinding/oil/purchases/expenses/invoices remain in DB — recommend broader cleanup in future iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_agrimill.py uses -n 0 (serial) via `python -m pytest -n 0` because tests share state (product_id/sale_id via pytest module attributes). pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` which runs classes in parallel and breaks the ordering — always pass `-n 0` on the CLI. External URL used from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Dashboard currently shows leftover test data (₹1600 sales, 2 grinding, 2 oil, 6 notifications) — subsequent runs should clear collections if needed. All data-testids match those in review request.
